content: Another system known as Open Registry BIBREF7 is capable of filtering the reports with disease codes containing cancer. In BIBREF8 , an approach called Automated Retrieval Console (ARC) is proposed which uses machine learning models to predict the degree of association of a given pathology or radiology with the cancer. The performance ranges from an F-measure of 0.75 for lung cancer to 0.94 for colorectal cancer. However, ARC uses domain-specific rules which hiders with the generalization of the approach to variety of pathology reports.
